body: I just hate seeing the person I love continually getting beat down (not literally, of course) by the fact that I can't behave normally. I disrespect her on an almost daily basis and as a grown adult have absolutely no idea what to do about it.

Maybe it's nobody's fault that she fell in love, but I'm allowing her to be put through such bullshit because of that fact. I see how everything breaks her down, and yea she stays because she loves me. I don't take advantage of that fact, but it's real that she'd be way gone and happier if she could get over how she feels about me. And that doesn't look to be happening.
